probe_profiles.label: mid-size single -- PLACEHOLDER, MEASURE BEFORE USE

_comment.probe_profiles: REQUIRED. One entry per probe design, identified by how many EM sensors it presents. The profile is chosen automatically from the sensor count in the first Viper frame and then latched, so switching probes means changing what is plugged in -- nothing here needs editing to switch. Startup fails if this block is missing or malformed; there is no default tip offset.
_comment.probe_profiles.sensor_count: REQUIRED. Number of connected EM sensors this profile applies to. Each count may appear at most once.
_comment.probe_profiles.label: Optional name, echoed to the log when the profile is selected.
_comment.probe_profiles.tip_offset_m: REQUIRED. [x, y, z] offset in metres from the fused sensor origin to the probe tip, expressed in the sensor frame. x is the along-probe direction; y and z are horizontal offsets to the probe centre and are normally 0.
_comment.probe_profiles.tip_rotation_zyx_deg: Optional [azimuth, elevation, roll] in degrees, rotating the sensor frame onto the tip frame (the Viper's own Z-Y-X convention). Omit for identity, which is correct when the sensor is mounted along the probe axis. It rotates the published orientation as well as placing the tip.
_comment.probe_profiles.WARNING: The 1-sensor tip_offset_m above is a placeholder copied from the 3-sensor value and is NOT correct. The 3-sensor number is the centroid-of-three to tip distance; a single sensor sits somewhere else on the probe. Measure it before trusting single-sensor data.
_comment.minimum_contact_force: (NOT USED) the force threshold, above which we have contact
_comment.pressure_usb_id: USB VID:PID (hex) of the pressure sensor; the serial port is auto-detected by matching this. Required (no port fallback). Windows and Linux only; must match exactly one connected device or the sensor stays disabled
_comment.use_hardware_contact: If true, use the 0/1 contact flag reported by the device; if false, derive contact from force thresholds and contact_require_fN
_comment.contact_require_f1: Whether force sensor 1 is required to be above minimum_contact_force (only used when use_hardware_contact is false)
_comment.contact_require_f2: Whether force sensor 2 is required to be above minimum_contact_force
_comment.contact_require_f3: Whether force sensor 3 is required to be above minimum_contact_force
_comment.contact_require_f4: Whether force sensor 4 is required to be above minimum_contact_force
_comment.generate_geometry: Generate point clouds, mesh, and the scene trail locally; set false if a downstream component generates them
